caption: The drawing depicts a dark brown, statue-like figure of a standing human, rendered with a realistic texture suggestive of metal. The figure wears a feathered or ornamented headdress and a knee-length tunic with a cloak draped over one shoulder. The left arm is bent across the body, while the right hand holds a staff or stick that extends to the ground. A quiver of arrows is slung over the figure's left shoulder, indicated by several visible fletchings near the head. The legs are apart, and the figure stands atop an irregular, textured base that may represent rock or ground. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the monochromatic, textured drawing of the figure. The artist's signature, "A.L. Drouais," appears in small writing near the bottom of the base.
title: Cast Iron Ornament
